mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-detail.hours), 0) AS hours, COALESCE(SUM(-detail.costing_amount), 0) AS costing_amount, COALESCE(SUM(-detail.billing_amount), 0) AS billing_amount FROM oa_timesheet_detail detail JOIN oa_timesheet sheet ON sheet.timesheet_id = detail.timesheet_id AND sheet.tenant_id = detail.tenant_id WHERE detail.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND detail.reversal_of_detail_id = #{detailId} AND detail.deleted = 0 AND sheet.deleted = 0 AND sheet.status IN ('DRAFT', 'SUBMITTED', 'APPROVING', 'APPROVED') AND sheet.timesheet_id != #{excludeId}

SELECT project.* FROM oa_project project WHERE project.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND project.deleted = 0 AND project.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'ARCHIVED') AND (project.owner_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oa_project_member member WHERE member.project_id = project.project_id AND member.tenant_id = project.tenant_id AND member.user_id = #{userId} AND member.deleted = 0 AND (member.leave_date IS NULL OR member.leave_date >= CURRENT_DATE) )) ORDER BY project.project_id DESC

SELECT project.* FROM oa_project project WHERE project.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND project.deleted = 0 AND project.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'ARCHIVED') AND (project.owner_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oa_project_member member WHERE member.project_id = project.project_id AND member.tenant_id = project.tenant_id AND member.user_id = #{userId} AND member.deleted = 0 AND (member.join_date IS NULL OR member.join_date <= LEAST(#{toDate}, CURRENT_DATE)) AND (member.leave_date IS NULL OR member.leave_date >= #{fromDate}) )) ORDER BY project.project_id DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(detail.costing_amount), 0) AS labor_cost_amount, COALESCE(SUM(detail.billing_amount), 0) AS billable_amount, COALESCE(SUM(detail.hours), 0) AS actual_hours, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(purchase.total_amount), 0) FROM biz_purchase_request purchase WHERE purchase.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND purchase.project_id = #{projectId} AND purchase.deleted = 0 AND purchase.status = 'RECEIVED') AS purchase_cost_amount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(invoice.gross_amount), 0) FROM oa_invoice invoice JOIN oa_contract contract ON contract.contract_id = invoice.contract_id AND contract.tenant_id = invoice.tenant_id WHERE invoice.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND contract.project_id = #{projectId} AND contract.deleted = 0 AND invoice.deleted = 0 AND invoice.invoice_direction = 'OUTPUT' AND invoice.status != 'VOID') AS billed_amount FROM oa_timesheet_detail detail JOIN oa_timesheet sheet ON sheet.timesheet_id = detail.timesheet_id AND sheet.tenant_id = detail.tenant_id WHERE detail.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND detail.project_id = #{projectId} AND detail.deleted = 0 AND sheet.deleted = 0 AND sheet.status = 'APPROVED'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(detail.hours), 0) FROM oa_timesheet_detail detail JOIN oa_timesheet sheet ON sheet.timesheet_id = detail.timesheet_id AND sheet.tenant_id = detail.tenant_id WHERE detail.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND detail.task_id = #{taskId} AND detail.deleted = 0 AND sheet.deleted = 0 AND sheet.status = 'APPROVED'
